versions.changelog:
Battlecard Competitive Intelligence and Sales Practice 1.8.0

- New title and description: battle cards for any competitor, then a scored practice call against an AI buyer. Battlecard is conversation readiness for B2B sales teams: score every call, rehearse every gap.
- README and glama.json updated to match; version aligned across SKILL.md and skill.json.
- Tools, scripts and pricing unchanged.

Battlecard 0.1.0 updates the skill’s positioning and package metadata.

- Reframed the skill around competitive intelligence and scored AI-buyer sales practice.
- Updated the title and description with the “score every call, rehearse every gap” messaging.
- Added LICENSE and glama.json; removed skill-card.md.
- Updated 4 files and added 2 files; removed 1 file.

Security fix: removed eval, added jq escaping. Fixed metadata mismatch: BATTLECARD_API_KEY now declared in both SKILL.md and skill.json. Added 25 buyer personas with company size tiers. Updated SKILL.md to v1.5.0.

## battlecard-competitive-intelligence v1.4.1

- Improved onboarding prompt to clarify user can practice with text or voice ("Say 'simulate' to practice by text, or 'voice simulate' to practice with voice messages.")
- Updated simulation flow: if a user sends a voice note, all subsequent simulation turns use voice automatically.
- Simulation responses now display scores with change annotations and concise, actionable coaching.
- Debrief output after ending a simulation is now exactly 2 messages for clarity and brevity.
- Minor instruction updates for simulation and voice simulation user experience.

**battlecard-competitive-intelligence v1.4.0**

- Added 8 new scripts for direct CLI access: battlecard, simulations (start, continue, end), competitor comparison, objection handlers, and pre-call briefings.
- Users can now use competitive intelligence features immediately via scripts—no MCP setup required for the basics.
- Updated documentation to reflect both script (direct) and MCP usage, including quick start instructions and examples.
- Free tier enhanced: first 4 battle cards and 2 simulations available instantly without signup.
- Retains session context for company and competitor to streamline user experience.

Version 1.3.0 introduces onboarding for first-time users and enhanced context memory.

- New onboarding flow: Asks for your company and top competitor on first use, auto-generates a battle card, and offers a simulation tailored to your business.
- Remembers company and competitor for the whole session, so you don’t have to repeat them for new simulations.
- Improved flow for adding or switching competitors mid-session.
- After the first battle card, suggests preparing competitive briefings for your next sales call.
- At the end of each simulation debrief, encourages improvement with progress stats and highlights team adoption.

Version 1.2.1 (no file changes from 1.2.0):

- No changes detected. This release contains no updates to functionality, configuration, or documentation.
- All features and setup remain as described in version 1.2.0.

Voice simulation support and interactive debrief added.

- Introduced AI-powered voice sales simulations (including mixed text/voice modes).
- Updated simulation flow to support starting, continuing, and ending voice-based roleplays.
- Added interactive debrief after simulations, breaking summary and coaching into clear steps.
- Revised free and paid plan limits to reflect new simulation and voice usage.
- Clarified tool descriptions and usage in the documentation.

Simulation features added for interactive sales training.

- Added support for starting, continuing, and ending competitive sales simulations with AI-powered prospects.
- Detailed usage instructions for running simulations, including flow, scoring, and debriefs.
- Updated pricing to include daily simulation limits per tier.
- Expanded the list of available tools in the documentation.

- Increased free tier queries from 1 to 4 in the setup and pricing sections.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new free tier limit.

Initial release of battlecard-competitive-intelligence skill.

- Provides real-time, AI-powered battle cards, objection handlers, and sales intelligence.
- Supports competitor comparisons, pricing analysis, objection handling, and pre-call briefings.
- Integrates with Battlecard API via MCP server configuration.
- Tailored for sales teams needing up-to-date competitive data.
- Includes tiered pricing with free, Starter, Pro, and Team plans.
